description: List verified manufacturers published on Gemalli. Returns each producer's name, country, certifications and profile identifier in the requested language, newest first. USE THIS whenever the question is about COMPANIES rather than goods: "who makes X", "which factories/producers/suppliers are on the platform", "show me manufacturers from <country>". A question about companies stays this tool even when it names a product — search_products returns goods, not the companies behind them. To find a specific product or filter goods by country, use search_products. RESPONSE SIZE: `count` is how many are in THIS response, `total` is how many exist. When `has_more` is true you have seen only the first `count` of `total` — either call again with a larger `limit` (up to 50) or tell the person you checked the first N of M. Never conclude that a company or product type is absent from the platform from a partial list.

locale.description: Preferred locale for returned text. Defaults to "en".
